_help: Copy this file to config.json (same folder) and change the values. Lines starting with _ are just notes. Use forward slashes / in folder paths, even on Windows.
_watch_folder: Put movie files here (and an optional .srt with exactly the same name). They're sent to GitHub to be cut.
_output_folder: Finished parts arrive in <this>/Ready to post/<movie>/<mode>/. Originals go to <this>/Done afterwards (or <this>/Failed).
_download_folder: Public-domain films from your wish list are downloaded here first.
_github: Your GitHub name, the repo, and a fine-grained token for that repo only with 'Contents: Read and write' AND 'Actions: Read and write'.
_ntfy_topic: Your ntfy notification name (the one you subscribed to in the ntfy app). Left empty, the installer makes one and tells you.
_original_after: What happens to your original movie file once its parts are back: move (to <output_folder>/Done), keep (leave it where it is) or delete.
_composio: Only for automatic TikTok posting (switch it on in the app; needs  py -m pip install composio  once). See plan/COMPOSIO-NOTES.md. posting_dry_run: true = only write in the log what would be posted.
_timing: Seconds between folder checks, seconds a file must stop growing, seconds between checks for finished parts, minutes between wish-list checks.
_max_download_mb: Skip archive.org files bigger than this (MB).
